title: Enhancing reproducibility in hybrid Earth system models
summary:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 28 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01299-5

AI integration in Earth system models enhances prediction and modelling capabilities but also amplifies challenges for reproducibility. This Perspective introduces a framework for assessing reproducibility and provides practical ways to strengthen reproducibility in hybrid Earth system models.

title: Large language models as uncertainty-calibrated optimizers for experimental discovery
summary:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 28 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01283-z

Although language models can be helpful in molecular design, they are not typically calibrated for uncertainty. Rankovic and colleagues present a method to train language models while taking into account the uncertainty of the data.
